# Current design and product integration

<!-- Generated by tools/sync_current_design.py from design/current_product.json. -->

Exact functional source 042b7689 passed all 1558 actual tests in 36 locked suites, EP4/EP5 native execution and independent readers, and 36442 complete pair domains across three fixed poses. EP4 retains 55 geometric rejections. A separate accessory diagnostic cleared all 1099 continuous pair domains. Full motion remains open: KEY has preserved partial positive evidence; SLIDE native v2 was stopped by the original shared-memory guard after five factory-law probes with no recoverable completed pair rows; SEATING could not start within its original resource gates. Full original L2 K operators were faithfully rebuilt; panel response reached all 3885 columns but failed the original five-probe residual guard, and the new diagnostic could not start within its resource budget. Hosted jobs have no steps or runners. Real inputs, full motion, tolerances, structural qualification and G3-G5 hardware evidence remain unresolved.

## Product and platform

Equal finished A/B envelopes; one approximately 7-inch flexible main OLED; flat storage in B; B moves upward 79.75 mm and seats normally by 8.20 mm; A has larger-cell priority. The 4700 mAh target uses cell-label sum at a common reference voltage; it is not verified terminal Ah for an unknown pack topology and is not a selected cell pair.

The implementation baseline is `a1b3cc1e0773446f2e36d0a607edf61211dd9919`. The donor reuse design decision and unknown physical identities are in [product interfaces](design/product_interfaces.json); project geometry and reservation assumptions are in [product geometry](design/product_geometry.json).

Accepted PR34 evidence closes the retained normalized installation and fixed-adjustment service model. It does not determine real preload, torque, material strength or phone capacity. The original eight cases and later L1/L2 cases remain versioned results, not fresh reruns. The product candidate cuts A_FRAME, A_BACK_PANEL and B_SHELL and adds supports; the original FE closure does not structurally qualify those new solids.

## Actual build and measurements

Formal collection on 2026-10-20 used the existing Pocket4 ADB service at 127.0.0.1:5061: 17 read-only commands succeeded, transport ID stayed 37, server boot/PID/start identity stayed unchanged, and source/design inputs matched exact f4db100. The imported record retains XT2551-3 only; ten other identity fields remain null, no seven-role physical inventory is supplied, and all 12 physical terminal interfaces remain unbound. ro.boot.hwrev is empty and is not converted into a board revision. Earlier software observations (3430/1140 mAh design values, 4570 mAh sum) and Chinese OEM manual values (4700 typical / 4540 rated mAh) keep their own dates and distinct scope. They do not prove the 4700-mAh layout. Actual board/module labels, dimensions, COF, cells/tabs/swelling, terminal topology, RF/thermal space and modified-phone measurements are still required. See engineering/product-integration-20261018/phase3-20261020/hardware/DONOR_IMPORT.md.

Study CAD can be generated and unpowered research coupons can be prepared while physical inputs remain incomplete. A study export does not assert whole-phone fit, electrical operation or a completed physical test.

Full implementation commands, generated outputs and measured/rejected results are in [the integration delivery](engineering/product-integration-20261018/README.md). Historical entry points remain available at the recorded baseline commit and in the original experiments.
